responsibility: Implements the C-family diagnostic support classes for explaining type mismatches with rich source ranges. This file provides the runtime behavior behind range labels that describe an expression’s type in comparison with another type, and constructs binary-operation rich_location objects that either highlight the operator and both operands separately or fall back to a combined location when source positions are incomplete. It therefore belongs to the front-end diagnostics subsystem, consuming tree expressions and op_location_t source locations and producing range-labeled, colorized diagnostic context used by higher-level warning and error reporters.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation file for the c-type-mismatch pair: it defines the runtime behavior declared in c-type-mismatch.h, including maybe_range_label_for_tree_type_mismatch::get_text, binary_op_rich_location construction, and the logic that chooses between operator-centered and combined source locations when building diagnostics.
